description: Whether a build can be sent to the workspace's Microsoft Intune as a line of business app (an enterprise or ad hoc signed .ipa, or an APK; App Store or development signed .ipa files and .aab uploads cannot) and why not, the status of the Intune connection (OK, ERROR with the reason in plain words, or not connected; never the client secret), and every send so far: new app or new version, Intune app name and id, status (queued, sending, sent, failed) and the result. AppForShare only hands the file to Intune; assignment to groups stays in Intune. Sending is done by an Admin in the dashboard or with the CLI (appforshare store-upload <build> --to intune --yes), never from here. Read only. Team.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

name: intune_status
title: Microsoft Intune sends of a build
